skill_path: You have a strong foundation in administration, coordination, and critical thinking. By focusing on budgeting and FP&A now, and building bridge skills in accounting and reporting, you'll be well on your way to a successful finance career. Keep pushing forward!

│   └── Board Materials
├── Core Missing Skills (Needed Now)

│   └── FP&A

    └── Goal Skills (Future)
        └── (Continue building expertise)
steps: Enroll in a budgeting course (e.g., Coursera's 'Budgeting and Forecasting') to master core financial planning.
Learn FP&A basics via online resources (e.g., CFI's FP&A certification) and apply to real scenarios.
Strengthen accounting skills by taking an introductory accounting course (e.g., Udemy's 'Accounting in 60 Minutes').
Gain hands-on experience with accounts payable and annual report preparation through a part-time role or internship.
Practice audit support and board materials by volunteering for financial committees or assisting a mentor.
skill_tree.summary: You have a strong foundation in administration, coordination, and critical thinking. By focusing on budgeting and FP&A now, and building bridge skills in accounting and reporting, you'll be well on your way to a successful finance career. Keep pushing forward!
